EmailTemplate.name: MM to DMA Prescreening Waiver
EmailTemplate.subject: Prescreening Waiver
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for contacting the School of Music Admissions office. Since you are a current student in BLANK, you will not need to submit the prescreening audition for the Doctor of Musical Arts: Performance application. However, because the application requires a prescreening video, please prepare a short audio recording stating the following:
Current Major Studio Instructor The prescreening requirement is waived because you are a current master’s student
When you are ready to submit your application, please request a promo code for the $25 prescreening fee by emailing MusicAdmissions@asu.edu. Please note that you will still need to pay the $10 application fee.
Thanks,
Julie Stephens Coordinator, Academic Affairs + Admissions Arizona State University | Herberger Institute for Design and the Arts P.O. Box 870405 | Tempe, Arizona 85287-0405 Phone: 480-965-5069 {!Case.Thread_Id}
